description: You received a confusing medical Explanation of Benefits (EOB) document. Open the raw EOB data at /home/ga/Documents/eob_raw_data.txt and the CPT codes reference at /home/ga/Documents/cpt_codes_reference.txt. Create a clear spreadsheet that: (1) organizes all line items with human-readable procedure descriptions, (2) calculates accurate totals and identifies the billing discrepancy, (3) flags denied claims, and (4) creates a questions section for the insurance company. Save as /home/ga/Documents/EOB_Decoded_2024.xlsx (Ctrl+S).
